newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: RAM raises long-term rating of Multi-Purpose to A1.
newsitem.headline: RAM raises long-term rating of Multi-Purpose to A1.

text.p: Malaysia Rating Agency (RAM) said on Monday it was upgrading the long-term rating of Multi-Purpose Bank Bhd to A1 from A2.
In a statement, RAM said it also reaffirmed the short-term rating of the bank at P1. The bank is a unit of Kuala Lumpur-listed Multi-Purpose Holdings Bhd.
"The ratings reflect the continuing improvement in the bank's asset quality, profit performance and strong loan loss reserve levels," the agency said.
The bank has expanded its loan portfolio in the last two years to strengthen its earnings base, a development which had strained the bank's capital adequacy and funding structure, RAM said.
"Of more concern is the bank's ability to maintain the integrity of the large number of loans it had written over the past two years," the agency said.
